world.presentation: continuous textured terrain; tile grid must not be visually exposed

player.facing_rule: all frames are diagonal 3/4; no front-facing sprite and no mirror-only substitution
player.appearance_rule: reconstruct the old Dark Ages peasant starter appearance from P0/P1 references; do not reuse martial-artist clothing or silhouette

paper_doll.rule: class/equipment visuals are layered over the peasant-compatible base; martial artist is not the base character

acceptance: starter character reads as old Dark Ages peasant, not martial artist
side-by-side reads as old Dark Ages before it reads as generic retro MMORPG
character silhouette remains connected in every frame
foot anchor does not drift across IDLE/WALK
terrain reads continuously at gameplay zoom
no runtime wiring until visual gate passes
